PATNA HIGH COURT
NOTICE
Pursuant to the Order dated 11.03.2026 passed by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in
Civil Appeal No. 3947 of 2020 (Rejanish K.V. versus K. Deepa & Ors.) and other
connected cases, the Court have been pleased to reinstate Sri Santosh Kumar who is
presently working as District & Additional Sessions Judge, Saharsa, to the post of
District & Additional Sessions Judge under the District Judge (Entry Level) , Direct from
Bar Exam-2016.
Court's earlier notice dated 12.01.2021 so far as it relates to him stands modified
to the above extent.
Patna High Court, Patna
Date: 02.09.2026
By order of the Court
